limitations.quote: // Reuse the final zero as the first bit of a possible next match.
limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed the post-match transitions, preserving the final zero across invalid cycles and reusing it for overlaps that the original FSM discards.
The test used a sliding window of valid bits as its oracle, so it accepted the new overlap behavior instead of checking that the original post-match transitions were preserved.
